sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at a bakery across from my hotel.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want some bread for a picnic in the park.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I have a loaf of bread, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, what kind of bread would you like today?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'd like the cheese loaf on the board, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry, we're out of cheese bread, but we've still got the plain loaf.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which loaf have you still got?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The plain loaf.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, is the plain loaf three pounds like the sign says?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and there's a small loaf in this basket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I look at the loaf and think about our picnic.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll take that plain loaf for our picnic, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, would you like me to slice it for you?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, please, is there an extra charge for that?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, we'll slice it for free.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, please slice the whole loaf for our picnic.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Could you make the slices thin, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll cut it into thin slices for sandwiches.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, can you put it in a paper bag too?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll put it in a bag for you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I take out my card while the baker packs the bread.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I pay by card for just one loaf?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, you can pay by card for any amount.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So it's three pounds with the slicing and the bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's three pounds in total.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll pay by card, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just tap your card here when you're ready.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, can I have the receipt as well?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, here's your receipt and your bag.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, that's everything I need for the picnic.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I leave with the sliced bread and head to the park.
